テキスト cha 212: Eiichiro Niimura's end as a divine messenger. His mind is buried in Shigatsu Youka; he only utters words, whatever his intent. Lacking the lower body the dead do not need, he cannot leave Shigatsu Youka.
His mission as a 'divine messenger' fulfilled, he has no intellect left: an 'organ' that exists only to keep Shigatsu Youka alive. Whether he thinks it an honor or a humiliation, no one knows.

Part of Shigatsu Youka as a divine messenger, he too vanishes when the main body is fatally wounded. Had all four gathered, they would reportedly have resisted third-generation blood and lived almost forever.
